title.narrative: The purpose of the Fund is to allow a harmonised and effective delivery of international financial support over several years by pooling nonreimbursable contributions to be used primarily for supporting energy efficiency and environmental projects, resulting in a significant energy savings, reduction of carbon dioxide (CO2) and other greenhouse gases (GHG) emissions. wledge on the difficulties faced by women politicians and on actions to support them East Darfur States .

description.narrative: Indirectly the implementation of E5P projects will achieve the following results: a) Improved the regulatory and enforcement capacity of public sector bodies such as relevant Ministries, tariff regulators and other local public sector counterparts;b) Enhanced operation and financial capacity at utility level. Municipal client will benefit from corporate development plans and increased capacity through project implementation with the E5P Implementing Agencies;c) Improve Policy Dialogue leading to appropriate legal and regulatory framework being put in place in the sectors of intervention;d) Tariff reform within affordability constraints to build financial and operational sustainability;e) Capacity building at local, contributing to a higher degree of decentralisation;f) Supervision and monitoring capacity enhancement at all levels in accordance with international standards of the E5P Implementing Agencies. ses.3.5 Enhanced shared knowledge on new development areas.
